name: features.by_bbox
description: Fetch all geo features within a bounding box
querySql: SELECT f.id, f.external_id, f.source_table, ST_AsGeoJSON(f.geometry)::jsonb AS geometry, f.attributes, f.updated_at FROM tessera.geo_features f WHERE ST_Intersects(f.geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(:minLon, :minLat, :maxLon, :maxLat, 4326)) AND f.source_id = COALESCE(:sourceId::uuid, f.source_id) ORDER BY f.updated_at DESC LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset
